model: WZU-485E-BAC BACnet MS/TP module for UH50 / UC50 ultrasonic heat meters
applies_to: Siemens / Landis+Gyr UH50 (firmware 5.15 and later) and UC50 ultrasonic heat and cooling meters fitted with the WZU-485E-BAC module in slot 1.
summary: The WZU-485E-BAC plugs into slot 1 of a UH50 or UC50 ultrasonic heat meter and serves its data on BACnet MS/TP. It has 12 read-only Analog Inputs: serial number, energy and tariff registers, volume, flow, power, an info (error) code and the hot, cold and differential temperatures. The module needs its own 24 V supply.
default_device_instance: Last 6 digits of the meter serial number
notes: The object table has no access column; all objects are meter readings and are listed as read-only.
Energy units follow the meter display (kWh, MWh, MJ or GJ).
AI 6 and AI 7 hold tariff registers 2 and 3, or the accumulated volume of pulse inputs 1 and 2 when those are enabled (only with the UltraAssist service software).
The device object name is UH50-RS485.
Data refresh: every 60 min in stand-by, and after each data request (up to 10 s) in operation. On battery-powered meters a read-out interval under 10 minutes needs a D-cell battery.

integration.summary: Fit the module in slot 1, power it from a separate 24 V supply, set the MAC address (on the meter for module firmware v1-v4, or with the WZU-485 Configuration Tool for v5+) and baud, then read energy, power, flow, temperatures and the info code.

minimum_points.name: Energy
minimum_points.why: Energy total, unit as meter display

setup: MAC address 1-127 (BACnet master). Module firmware v1-v4: MAC = the meter's M-Bus primary address for slot 1 (AP1), set at the meter; v5 and later: set with the WZU-485 Configuration Tool over micro-USB.
The meter's default address 0 must be changed.
Device instance defaults to the last 6 digits of the meter serial number; set another with the configuration tool (v1.43+) or over BACnet; writing 0 restores the serial-number rule.
Use an external 120 ohm termination resistor; the RS-485 side is not isolated from the network.
gotchas: Never connect the 24 V supply to the A+/B- terminals; it can destroy the module.
Only slot 1 may hold this module; slot 2 may only hold an M-Bus module, and only one of them can run fast read-out (under 15 min).
Turn off the module's supply before connecting the USB configuration cable.

points.name: Energy
points.description: Standard energy register: heat (heat/combined meter) or cooling (cooling meter)
points.units: kWh, MWh, MJ or GJ (as meter display)

points.name: Tariff 1 cooling if comb. meter
points.description: Tariff register 1; cooling energy on combined meters

points.name: Tariff 2 OR: Pulse input 1 accumulated
points.description: Tariff register 2, or pulse input 1 volume if enabled

points.name: Tariff 3 OR: Pulse input 2 accumulated
points.description: Tariff register 3, or pulse input 2 volume if enabled

points.name: Info code
points.description: Error code: 0 none, 3 internal, 5 flow, 6-9 temperature sensors
points.states: 0=No error, 3=Internal errors (F3, F4, F7, F8, F9), 5=Flow rate error (F0, F9, F4), 6=Hot side sensor open (F1), 7=Hot side sensor short (F5), 8=Cold side sensor open (F2), 9=Cold side sensor short (F6)

points.name: Temperature hot side
points.description: Hot side temperature (combined meter in heat mode)

points.name: Temperature cold side
points.description: Cold side temperature (combined meter in heat mode)
